results.title: Alien Breed Returns Next Month with Massive PS5 Compilation, Complete with Horde Mode
results.description: Gallery content like interviews and artwork, too. Team 17’s sci-fi shooter Alien Breed , celebrating its 35th anniversary this year, will return in September with an epic compilation akin to the gold standard Digital Eclipse bundles. This will feature every game from the first era of the franchise, including the Alien Breed 3D titles. Read the full article on pushsquare.com
